What is This Part?
These are the Screws for the the Targa Bar and Door Rails.

Qty 30 – Screws (3 Different Sizes – Qty 12, Qty 8 & Qty 10)

Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
